title: The Star Door Mystery
level_model: one continuous fixed-stage animated story adventure with eight causally connected scenes and direct environmental mini-games

level_select.level_2: visible as the next in-development book-and-game milestone

mobile_navigation_guard: the application root and game stages use fixed-height overflow containment and overscroll-behavior none to prevent accidental pull-to-refresh or swipe-off scrolling
narrative_cause_chain: the waking Star Door supplies the note and introduces the question
the note establishes five clues and the visible map establishes five star spaces
five checked clues light stars one through five
five stars open the Star Door
two doors resolve the parcel's question
a delayed library recall asks the child to retrieve an earlier clue without giving its answer
visual_system: six original generated 16:9 story environments; a visible generated Mira sprite; permanent animated main trio Sol, Tavi and Mira; one clearly introduced E01 guest, Nori; unmistakable emoji interaction objects; walking, idling, speaking, star and reveal animation
interaction_system: spot a written note among familiar objects
mini_game_policy: Every stage in every level or book contains a short replayable learning mini-game with direct input, visible feedback and a clear learning purpose; narrative-only stages are not permitted.
sound_system: 34 caption-matched local Kokoro narration lines plus offline Web Audio movement, interaction, door and star effects
callback_policy: Sol, Tavi and Mira are permanent; each level or book introduces at most one new guest; previous guests return only when relevant through natural narrative encounters or optional post-attempt hints and never identify a new answer

final_publication.note: Awaiting Maria Smith's review and explicit approval; hosting requires separate authorisation and a cleared production dependency audit.
